Class DelayAction

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.action.impl.AbstractAction
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.action.impl.actions.DelayAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Action
public class DelayAction extends AbstractAction
Wraps child actions and executes them after a configurable delay.

Uses Bukkit's BukkitScheduler.runTaskLater() for tick-based, main-thread-safe delayed execution. This ensures compatibility with the Bukkit API which is not thread-safe.

YAML configuration:

type: delay
ticks: 40    # 2 seconds (20 ticks = 1 second)
actions:
  - type: message
    message: "<yellow>Delayed message!"
  - type: sound
    sound: ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP

  • Method Details

    • execute

      public ActionResult execute(ExecutionContext context)
      Executes this action within the given context.

      Schedules the child actions for delayed execution. Returns ActionResult.success() immediately — the delayed actions run asynchronously on the main thread after the specified ticks.

      Parameters:
      context - the execution context containing player, sender, and metadata
      Returns:
      the result of the execution; never null
